name: AI Impact Tracker — Nightly Mart ETL (api.btc)

parameters.query: SELECT Id, csbs__Commission_Amount__c, csbs__Funded_Date__c, Assisted_by__c FROM Opportunity WHERE StageName = 'Funded' AND csbs__Commission_Amount__c != null AND Assisted_by__c INCLUDES ('Inbox Manager - AI','Marketing - EW','Marketing - MA','Marketing - AR','Marketing - FT','Marketing - GS','Marketing - LP','Marketing - OC','Marketing - JB','NYS Auto DNQ')
